rows.role_title: President of the Pan Africanist Congress of Azania
rows.text: The PAC statement says that under the order of 8 March 2019 "the NEC elected in December 2018, in Kimberly would be combined with that elected in Mpumalanga in 2017", forming the combined NEC.

rows.role_title: President of the Pan Africanist Congress of Azania
rows.text: The same statement says of the combined NEC's meeting of 18 May 2019 that "Mr Naruis Moloto chaired the said meeting as then President of the PAC."

locator.section: Paragraph beginning "Indeed the combined NEC met on 18 May 2019"

rows.role_title: President of the Pan Africanist Congress of Azania
rows.text: The same statement says "Mr Narius Moloto was then suspended on 20 th July 2019, for bringing the organisation into disrepute among other reasons".

locator.section: Paragraph beginning "Mr Narius Moloto was then suspended"

rows.role_title: President of the Pan Africanist Congress of Azania
rows.text: The same statement says "the only legitimate, legal and Constitutional Congress was held in Bloemfontein wherein Mr Mzwanele Nyhotso was elected President together with all NEC Members."

rows.role_title: President of the Pan Africanist Congress of Azania
rows.text: The same statement says "the PAC has approached the Electoral Court for final determination of the matter and awaits its decision".
